kebab_example: aliyun apig batch-import-http-apis --spec-content-base64  --spec-file-url https://oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/my-bucket/imports/batch.zip --spec-oss-config bucketName=my-bucket regionId=cn-hangzhou objectKey=imports/batch.zip --gateway-id gw-xxx --api-type Http --strategy ExistFirst --with-gateway-extension false --dry-run true --allow-update false --resource-group-id rg-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchImportHttpApis

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to overwrite existing APIs. If set to true, gatewayId is required
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许覆盖更新已有的API，设置为true时gatewayId必填
parameters.name: allow_update

parameters.help_en: Enables the dry run feature, which validates the definition without performing the actual import
parameters.help_zh: 预检功能，不进行导入只检查定义
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The gateway instance ID. For REST APIs, this parameter is required when withGatewayExtension is set to true or allowUpdate is set to true. For batch import of HTTP APIs, this parameter is always required
parameters.help_zh: 网关实例ID。REST API在withGatewayExtension为true或allowUpdate为true时必填；HTTP API批量导入必须传入
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The standard Base64 encoding of the raw bytes of the OAS ZIP package. The decoded size cannot exceed 10 MiB. This parameter cannot be specified together with specFileUrl or specOssConfig. Dry run is supported and returns validation results, but the dry run task result does not return a replayable importRequest
parameters.help_zh: OAS ZIP包原始字节的标准Base64编码。解码后最大10 MiB；不能与specFileUrl或specOssConfig同时传入。支持dryRun预检并返回检查结果，但Base64预检任务结果不返回可重放的importRequest
parameters.name: spec_content_base64

parameters.help_en: The download URL of the OAS ZIP file. The URL must support unauthenticated downloads. OSS URLs and whitelisted backend domain names are supported. At least one of specFileUrl and specOssConfig must be specified
parameters.help_zh: OAS ZIP文件的下载地址，需要支持免验证下载；支持OSS URL或后端白名单域名。specFileUrl和specOssConfig至少传入一个
parameters.name: spec_file_url

fields.help_en: The region ID of the OSS bucket
fields.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS configuration for the OAS file in ZIP format. At least one of specFileUrl and specOssConfig must be specified
parameters.help_zh: OAS文件的OSS配置，ZIP包格式。specFileUrl和specOssConfig至少传入一个
parameters.name: spec_oss_config

parameters.help_en: The conflict merge strategy during import. Default value: ExistFirst
parameters.help_zh: 导入时的冲突合并策略，默认ExistFirst
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to import with gateway extension configurations. This parameter must be set to true for batch import of HTTP APIs
parameters.help_zh: 是否携带网关扩展配置导入。HTTP API批量导入必须设置为true
parameters.name: with_gateway_extension

taskId.description_en: The asynchronous task ID. You can call the GetBatchImportTask operation to query the task progress
taskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID，可通过GetBatchImportTask接口查询任务进度
taskId.title_en: 异步任务ID，可通过GetBatchImportTask接口查询任务进度。
taskId.title_zh: 异步任务ID，可通过GetBatchImportTask接口查询任务进度。
